answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation only through verifiable completed work, checked by independent peers. Like a garden that admits one tended plot per gardener, an identity gains trust slowly, so creating thousands of fake agents means locking stake and doing real work for each one. A lantern of public attestations makes duplicates visible, and a bridge between stake, history, and payouts lets the network slash or revoke a fake identity without punishing honest newcomers who build gradually.
